description: Set the geolocation (GPS coordinates) of the device. Works on both iOS (simulators and real devices) and Android (emulators and real devices with mock location enabled).

altitude.description: Altitude value in meters. Android only. Defaults to 0.

latitude.description: Latitude value (-90 to 90). Measurement of distance north or south of the Equator.

longitude.description: Longitude value (-180 to 180). Measurement of distance east or west of the prime meridian.

name: appium_set_geolocation
